## Aim

We are updating the 2019 review of research data sharing [@chawinga2019] with scoping review methods from @cavallaro2026. The 2019 review matches our focus on research data sharing, which makes it a strong candidate for an update. Where it looks at differences across countries, we look at differences across research domains, with special attention on healthcare. Our method draws on the 2026 protocol, which pairs machine learning screening with automated deduplication, and improves on it in two places: deduplication and seed generation.

## Frameworks and Tools

We follow the PRISMA extension for scoping reviews (PRISMA-ScR) and the Joanna Briggs Institute scoping review (JBI) methodology. Both are standard for scoping reviews, make the work reproducible, and are supported by a broad ecosystem of tools and resources.

For deduplication we use ASySD (also used by @perrier2017), that, in contrast with Zotero workflow used by @cavallaro2026, is scriptable for reproducibility purposes. ASReview uses machine learning to rank records by predicted relevance, leveraging Naive Bayes text classification. It needs a seed sample to initialize the ranking. @cavallaro2026 select their seed sample ad-hoc from the first 5% of deduplicated records.

## Search and Seed

All four queries build on @chawinga2019. The base query takes their core term, "research data sharing" (RDS). The three concept queries extend that term with the vocabulary the field uses around it. Each pairs one key term (open data, data governance or open science) with "research data" or "data sharing" using AND, so a record must name both the concept and the data practice in its title or abstract. All four queries cover 2015 to 2025, which brackets the 2019 review and picks up where it left off. We ran them in PubMed, Scopus and Web of Science, translating field tags, date limits and document types for each database, and the appendix lists the full strings.

The base RDS query alone serves as the seed. It returned 308 records against 4,192 for the four queries combined (7.3%), modestly above the conventional 5%. A seed derived from a fixed keyword is reproducible, and its size stays near where a seed sample should land.

| Query | PubMed N (% of col.) | Scopus N (% of col.) | WoS N (% of col.) |

| Q1 research data sharing | 64 (6.1%) | 135 (7.8%) | 109 (7.7%) |
| Q2 open data | 352 (33.6%) | 644 (37.4%) | 564 (39.7%) |
| Q3 data governance | 219 (20.9%) | 348 (20.2%) | 255 (18.0%) |
| Q4 open science | 414 (39.5%) | 596 (34.6%) | 492 (34.6%) |
| **Column total** | **1,049** | **1,723** | **1,420** |

: Records retrieved per query and database, 2015 to 2025, before deduplication. Percentages give each query's share of the database's summed hits.

**Note:** All terms searched in titles and abstracts. Database-specific strings appear in the appendix. Results presented above have not yet been deduplicated.

Q1: `"research data sharing" OR "research data-sharing"`\
Q2: `"open data" AND ("research data" OR "data sharing")`\
Q3: `"data governance" AND ("research data" OR "data sharing")`\
Q4: `"open science" AND ("research data" OR "data sharing")`

## Manual annotation of seed sample

Terms from the second block of the prior draft query were implicitly grouped around five themes:

- Factors that obstruct
- Factors that facilitate
- Stakeholder perspectives
- Policies and what drive them
- Mechanisms for implementation

We repurposed these themes so that they may inform the screening strategy for annotating the seed.

## Appendix: Full Search Queries

### Generic Queries

Database-neutral core of the four queries. Each database adds its own field tags, date limits and document type filters. All terms are searched in titles and abstracts.

```sql
-- Q1: research data sharing (base RDS query)
"research data sharing" OR "research data-sharing"

-- Q2: open data
"open data"
AND ("research data" OR "data sharing")

-- Q3: data governance
"data governance"
AND ("research data" OR "data sharing")

-- Q4: open science
"open science"
AND ("research data" OR "data sharing")
```

### Scopus (1,723 records)

```sql
-- Q1 (135 records)
TITLE-ABS ( "research data sharing" OR "research data-sharing" )
AND PUBYEAR > 2014 AND PUBYEAR < 2026
AND DOCTYPE ( ar OR re )

-- Q2 (644 records)
TITLE-ABS ( "open data" )
AND TITLE-ABS ( "research data" OR "data sharing" )
AND PUBYEAR > 2014 AND PUBYEAR < 2026
AND DOCTYPE ( ar OR re )

-- Q3 (348 records)
TITLE-ABS ( "data governance" )
AND TITLE-ABS ( "research data" OR "data sharing" )
AND PUBYEAR > 2014 AND PUBYEAR < 2026
AND DOCTYPE ( ar OR re )

-- Q4 (596 records)
TITLE-ABS ( "open science" )
AND TITLE-ABS ( "research data" OR "data sharing" )
AND PUBYEAR > 2014 AND PUBYEAR < 2026
AND DOCTYPE ( ar OR re )
```
